ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Jlaive In-Memory Assembly Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of Jlaive to execute assemblies in a copied PowerShell

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX("\\\.bat$")) AND (((process_path = RGX("\\\\xcopy\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*powershell\\\.exe.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bat\\\.exe.*"))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\xcopy\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*pwsh\\\.exe.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bat\\\.exe.*"))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\attrib\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\+s.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\+h.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bat\\\.exe.*")))))
